item.title: Meningitis symptoms students should know: recognising the warning signs early
item.description: Recent UK meningitis cases highlight the need to recognise symptoms of meningitis and septicaemia early, especially among students and young adults.

item.title: Private MenB vaccination: who might consider it and how it works
item.description: Vaccination has transformed the prevention of meningitis in the UK. However, not all forms of meningococcal disease are covered by routine vaccination programmes for every age group. One of the most important strains still seen in the UK is meningococcal group B (MenB). While babies are routinely vaccinated against MenB, many teenagers and adults are not. item.title: What to do if you think you’ve been exposed to meningitis
item.description: Concerned about meningitis exposure? Learn how meningococcal disease spreads, who is at risk after a case nearby, and when you may need medical advice.

item.title: How to lower cortisol levels: 10 simple ways
item.description: You can lower cortisol by improving sleep, exercising regularly, managing stress, spending time in nature, limiting caffeine, and eating whole foods.

item.title: Everything you should know about the 3-day sardine fast
item.description: We take a closer look at where the sardine fast came from, the thinking behind it, and whether this unusual health trend really does what it says on the tin.

item.title: Transform your sleep: a guide to overcoming stress dreams
item.description: Stress dreams are similar to nightmares, with more everyday worries. When you're under a lot of stress, your mind continues to process this during sleep.

item.title: Is aloe vera good for your skin?
item.description: Aloe vera is very good for your skin. It is rich in skin-boosting ingredients such as vitamins A, C, and E, as well as being a source of healthy fats.

item.title: Specialist cancer treatment in the comfort of your own home
item.description: You can access cancer treatment at home, thanks to specialist providers such as Lloyds Clinical, who have been treating people in their homes for nearly 30 years.

item.title: Pelvic pain: a woman's guide to common causes
item.description: Pelvic pain in women can be caused by the reproductive, gastrointestinal, or urinary systems. Reviewed by a GP.

item.title: Antibiotic resistance: a hidden health crisis
item.description: Unnecessary use of antibiotics can weaken their effectiveness, leading to antibiotic resistance and making future infections harder to treat.
